description: What the plan-mode suite must notice of the plan model v2 (P9 ac-10, docs/PLAN-MODE.md "The plan and its revision"): the revision, the writer and the approval record of StudioWorkspace.plan(); the conflict of a stale base and of a model write over the owner's; the lazy migration of an old plan file; the one step per task; the model's tools (update_plan, studio.plan_set, exit_plan_mode) and their conflict result; the execution choice of an approval on the gate and in the runner; and the Hub routes that hold an answer to the plan file. The route refusals before any plan is read are in plan-routes.json (verify-studio-http), the client of the page in plan-ui.json.

mutations.name: P1
mutations.what: a write does not raise the revision

mutations.name: P2
mutations.what: every write is recorded as the model's

mutations.name: P3
mutations.what: a stale base is not a conflict

mutations.name: P4
mutations.what: a write of the model without a base replaces the owner's edit

mutations.name: P5
mutations.what: a write of the owner without a base is a conflict too

mutations.name: P6
mutations.what: two plan steps of a task run at once (no lock)

mutations.name: P7
mutations.what: a read migrates an old plan file at once (not lazily)

mutations.name: P8
mutations.what: a stored revision that is not a whole number is taken as a number

mutations.name: P9
mutations.what: a checklist write without a text clears the text

mutations.name: P10
mutations.what: a proposal replaces the checklist

mutations.name: P11
mutations.what: an approval is counted as an edit (a new revision)

mutations.name: P12

mutations.name: P13
mutations.what: a base that is not a whole number is not refused as such

mutations.name: P14
mutations.what: a negative revision counts as a whole number

mutations.name: P15
mutations.what: a proposal of any length is accepted
